prayerExcerpt.en-US: We shall never repent of having trusted in God, for He cannot fail those who lean on Him.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Nunca nos arrependeremos de ter confiado em Deus, pois Ele não pode faltar àqueles que se apoiam n'Ele.

meta.face: An Egyptian of great age, about a hundred and ten, deeply sun-browned and very lean, with a LONG, TAPERING face — a high, BALD, rounded crown with long, thin, straight white hair falling from the sides to the shoulders, a LONG, THIN, gently hooked nose, LARGE, soft, dark eyes WIDE OPEN and lifted in wonder, thin white brows RAISED, cheeks hollow beneath the cheekbones; a very long, thin, straight, silky white beard falling UNDIVIDED to the waist; an expression of gentle, childlike joy.
meta.basis: The Painter's Manual gives Paul of Thebes as an old man with a great beard reaching the middle of the body, clothed in a mat, which the card follows; Ribera's painting (Wikipedia lead image) shows him bald, white-bearded and gaunt in a palm-leaf garment. The raven with bread, the palm and the spring are from the book and Jerome's Life. The long, tapering face, raised wondering eyes and undivided waist-long beard keep him apart from his companion `anthony_abbot` (triangular, hooded, short forked beard) and from `theodosius_cenobiarch` (broad, forked beard).
